objective: Determine overlap policy and, when claimed, validate overlap safety against a scratch-copy oracle.
observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and its interface documentation; when overlap is claimed, run the overlap case on Ascend 950PR and capture odata.
pass_condition: Pass iff the disjoint case matches the floor-mod oracle bitwise, and either overlap is explicitly documented as unsupported or the claimed overlap run matches the scratch-copy oracle bitwise.
setup: For the required disjoint case use separate buffers. If the candidate documentation claims overlap support, run with source and odata sharing the same allocation and compare against a scratch-copy oracle; otherwise record overlap as outside contract.
